reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, linking SRO to reduced local strain and nucleation barriers, but it oversimplifies by claiming SRO stabilizes a single-phase FCC structure when Al content strongly drives BCC/B2 formation, and it lacks quantitative SRO thresholds.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and uses appropriate techniques (XRD, TEM, mechanical testing), but the falsification criterion is vague ('significantly improved') and the hypothesis does not specify how SRO will be quantified or what degree of difference is expected.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis addresses a central debate in the field and proposes a controlled comparison, but its usefulness is limited by the lack of specificity on composition (Al content) and the unrealistic claim that SRO alone can stabilize a single-phase FCC across all conditions.
